site.title: Generative AI — Cheat Sheets
site.tagline: Four algorithms from my handwritten GenAI-IITM.pdf notes (104 pages). Each one ships twice: as a self-contained interactive cheat sheet with an undergraduate-level PDF, and as an essay in the mnemonic medium with recall cards and a review deck.
site.footer: Every page is fully self-contained — no CDN, no network, works offline. Notation follows the source notes; the interactive demos are illustrative.

hero.eyebrow: IIT Madras · Mathematical Foundations of Generative AI
hero.title:
Four algorithms,
written twice each.
hero.lede: Generative adversarial networks, variational autoencoders, diffusion and RLHF — pulled from 104 pages of handwritten lecture notes. Every topic ships twice: once as a self-contained interactive cheat sheet you can read in ten minutes, and once as a long-form essay in the mnemonic medium, where recall cards inside the prose turn reading into remembering.

essay.title: Essays in the mnemonic medium
essay.sub: Long-form, story-first, with numbered recall cards in the prose and a review deck at the end of every Part.

reference.title: Reference sheet
reference.sub: The same material compressed for revision: tables, derivations, no memorisation aids.

cheatsheet.title: Interactive cheat sheets
cheatsheet.sub: One page per topic with a live visualiser, plus an undergraduate-level PDF.

topics.title: RLHF, for the very curious
topics.blurb: The same material in a mnemonic medium: story-first prose, 47 inline recall cards, an Anki-importable deck. Source pages 128–146 + the lecture.

topics.title: GANs, for the very curious
topics.blurb: f-divergence → the conjugate bound → an adversarial game → why it saturates → Wasserstein → inversion → FID. 8 parts, 21 recall cards.

topics.title: VAEs, for the very curious
topics.blurb: Why the likelihood is intractable → Jensen → the ELBO → EM and where it dies → the reparameterization trick → posterior collapse. 7 parts, 18 recall cards.

topics.title: Diffusion, for the very curious
topics.blurb: A VAE stretched over a thousand steps → the forward schedule → a bound in three terms → a regression on noise → guidance, latent diffusion, DDIM. 8 parts, 19 recall cards.

topics.title: RLHF & Alignment
topics.blurb: MDP → policy gradient → baseline/advantage → PPO → Bradley–Terry → DPO. Source pages 128–146, merged with the lecture transcript.

topics.title: Generative Adversarial Networks
topics.blurb: f-divergence → VDM → GAN → WGAN → BiGAN → cGAN → FID. Source pages 7–42.

topics.title: Variational Auto-Encoders
topics.blurb: MLE → Jensen → ELBO → EM/GMM → reparameterization → β-VAE → VQ-VAE. Source pages 43–71.

topics.title: Diffusion Models
topics.blurb: DDPM → ELBO → denoising → U-Net → score → guidance → LDM → DDIM. Source pages 72–110.
